theorems.statement: ((∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (β : Covector (Euclid N') k), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.compContinuousLinearMap A) ≤ ‖A‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ (∀ (N k : ℕ) (v : Euclid N) (β : Covector (Euclid N) (k + 1)), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.curryLeft v) ≤ ‖v‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ ∀ (N k : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid N) k) (τ : Fin k → Euclid N), Orthonormal ℝ τ → |α τ| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α)) → ∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → X.mass < ∞ → ∃ (G : ℕ → Euclid (k + 1) → Euclid N) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid (k + 1))) (w : ℕ → Euclid (k + 1) → ℤ) (c : ℕ → Euclid (k + 1) → ℝ), (∀ i, ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L (G i)) ∧ (∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (w i)) ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (c i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ u ∈ A i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (G i) u) ∧ (∀ i, G i '' A i ⊆ X.support) ∧ (∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun u => (w i u : ℝ)) (A i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ u ∈ A i, 0 ≤ c i u ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid N) (k + 1), |α (fun a => fderiv ℝ (G i) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))| ≤ c i u * covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ ∑' i, ∫⁻ u in A i, ENNReal.ofReal (|(w i u : ℝ)| * c i u) ≤ X.mass ∧ ∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1), HasSum (fun i => ∫ u in A i, (w i u : ℝ) * (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) (k + 1)) (G i u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ (G i) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) (X η)
